Step 3: Create defensible proxy entity IDs from observed data
```{r}
n <- nrow(df)

# Unique claim ID
df$ClaimID <- paste0("CLM_", seq_len(n))

# Proxy policyholder ID
if ("PolicyNumber" %in% names(df)) {
  df$PolicyHolderID <- paste0("PH_", df$PolicyNumber)
} else {
  ph_key <- paste(
    df$Age, df$Sex, df$MaritalStatus, df$AgeOfPolicyHolder,
    sep = "_"
  )
  df$PolicyHolderID <- paste0("PH_", as.integer(as.factor(ph_key)))
}

# Proxy agent ID
if ("RepNumber" %in% names(df)) {
  df$AgentID <- paste0("AG_", df$RepNumber)
} else {
  df$AgentID <- paste0("AG_", as.integer(as.factor(df$AgentType)))
}

# Proxy garage ID from observed claim context
garage_key <- paste(
  df$AccidentArea, df$Make, df$VehicleCategory,
  sep = "_"
)
df$GarageID <- paste0("GAR_", as.integer(as.factor(garage_key)))

cat("Unique claims:", length(unique(df$ClaimID)), "\n")
cat("Unique policyholder proxies:", length(unique(df$PolicyHolderID)), "\n")
cat("Unique agent proxies:", length(unique(df$AgentID)), "\n")
cat("Unique garage proxies:", length(unique(df$GarageID)), "\n")
```

Step 4: Safe sampling with both classes preserved
```{r}
max_rows <- nrow(df)

if (nrow(df) > max_rows) {
  
  fraud_df <- df %>% filter(FraudFound == 1)
  nonfraud_df <- df %>% filter(FraudFound == 0)
  
  if (nrow(fraud_df) == 0 || nrow(nonfraud_df) == 0) {
    stop("Step 4 error: one class is missing in the full dataset.")
  }
  
  # Keep both classes represented
  fraud_keep <- min(nrow(fraud_df), floor(max_rows * 0.5))
  nonfraud_keep <- min(nrow(nonfraud_df), max_rows - fraud_keep)
  
  fraud_sample <- fraud_df %>% sample_n(fraud_keep)
  nonfraud_sample <- nonfraud_df %>% sample_n(nonfraud_keep)
  
  df_gnn <- bind_rows(fraud_sample, nonfraud_sample) %>% arrange(ClaimID)
  
} else {
  df_gnn <- df
}

dim(df_gnn)
table(df_gnn$FraudFound)
```
Step 5: Prepare claim-node features
```{r}
# Numeric columns
numeric_cols <- c(
  "Age", "ClaimAmount", "Deductible", "DriverRating",
  "NumberOfCars", "NumberOfSuppliments"
)
numeric_cols <- intersect(numeric_cols, names(df_gnn))

# Candidate categorical columns
categorical_candidates <- c(
  "Sex", "MaritalStatus", "Fault", "PolicyType", "VehicleCategory",
  "PoliceReportFiled", "WitnessPresent", "AgentType", "BasePolicy",
  "AccidentArea", "VehiclePrice", "AgeOfVehicle", "AgeOfPolicyHolder",
  "Month", "MonthClaimed", "WeekOfMonth", "WeekOfMonthClaimed",
  "DayOfWeek", "Days.Policy.Accident", "Days.Policy.Claim",
  "PastNumberOfClaims", "Make"
)
categorical_candidates <- intersect(categorical_candidates, names(df_gnn))

# Keep only low-cardinality categorical columns
max_levels <- 20

categorical_cols <- categorical_candidates[
  sapply(df_gnn[categorical_candidates], function(x) length(unique(x))) <= max_levels
]

cat("Categorical columns kept for one-hot encoding:\n")
print(categorical_cols)

cat("Dropped high-cardinality categorical columns:\n")
print(setdiff(categorical_candidates, categorical_cols))

# Numeric matrix
X_num <- df_gnn[, numeric_cols, drop = FALSE] %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) %>%
  as.matrix()

# One-hot encode only compact categorical columns
if (length(categorical_cols) > 0) {
  dummies <- caret::dummyVars(~ ., data = df_gnn[, categorical_cols, drop = FALSE])
  X_cat <- predict(dummies, newdata = df_gnn[, categorical_cols, drop = FALSE])
  X_cat <- as.matrix(X_cat)
} else {
  X_cat <- matrix(0, nrow = nrow(df_gnn), ncol = 0)
}

# Combine
claim_features <- cbind(X_num, X_cat)

# Replace NA if any
claim_features[is.na(claim_features)] <- 0

# Scale
claim_features <- scale(claim_features)

cat("Final claim feature matrix dimensions:\n")
print(dim(claim_features))
```

Step 6: Build meaningful graph edges
```{r}
# Claim -> entity edges
edges_claim_ph <- data.frame(from = df_gnn$ClaimID, to = df_gnn$PolicyHolderID, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
edges_claim_agent <- data.frame(from = df_gnn$ClaimID, to = df_gnn$AgentID, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
edges_claim_garage <- data.frame(from = df_gnn$ClaimID, to = df_gnn$GarageID, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

make_shared_edges <- function(data, col_name, max_group_size = 5) {
  if (!(col_name %in% names(data))) {
    return(data.frame(from = character(), to = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  
  groups <- split(data$ClaimID, data[[col_name]])
  groups <- groups[sapply(groups, length) > 1]
  
  all_edges <- list()
  idx <- 1
  
  for (ids in groups) {
    if (length(ids) > max_group_size) ids <- sample(ids, max_group_size)
    if (length(ids) < 2) next
    
    pairs <- combn(ids, 2)
    all_edges[[idx]] <- data.frame(
      from = pairs[1, ],
      to   = pairs[2, ],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    idx <- idx + 1
  }
  
  if (length(all_edges) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(from = character(), to = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  
  bind_rows(all_edges)
}

# Keeping only a small number of shared-edge types
edges_shared_rep <- make_shared_edges(df_gnn, "RepNumber", max_group_size = 5)
edges_shared_area <- make_shared_edges(df_gnn, "AccidentArea", max_group_size = 5)

edges <- bind_rows(
  edges_claim_ph,
  edges_claim_agent,
  edges_claim_garage,
  edges_shared_rep,
  edges_shared_area
) %>%
  distinct()

cat("Total edges:", nrow(edges), "\n")
```

```{r}
nodes <- bind_rows(claim_nodes, ph_nodes, agent_nodes, garage_nodes) %>%
```

Step 9: Build labels and masks
```{r}
df_gnn$FraudFound <- as.integer(df_gnn$FraudFound)
df_gnn <- df_gnn %>% filter(!is.na(FraudFound))

# Labels
y_all <- rep(0, num_nodes)
claim_idx <- match(df_gnn$ClaimID, nodes$node_id)
y_all[claim_idx] <- df_gnn$FraudFound

# Check class counts
class_counts <- table(df_gnn$FraudFound)
print(class_counts)

if (!all(c(0, 1) %in% df_gnn$FraudFound)) {
  stop("Step 9 error: df_gnn must contain both classes 0 and 1.")
}

set.seed(42)

fraud_idx <- which(df_gnn$FraudFound == 1)
nonfraud_idx <- which(df_gnn$FraudFound == 0)

# Need at least 2 in each class to split into train/test
if (length(fraud_idx) < 2 || length(nonfraud_idx) < 2) {
  stop("Step 9 error: one class has fewer than 2 observations. Recheck Step 4.")
}

# Split each class separately so BOTH train and test contain both classes
train_fraud_n <- max(1, floor(0.8 * length(fraud_idx)))
train_nonfraud_n <- max(1, floor(0.8 * length(nonfraud_idx)))

# Prevent taking all rows from a class into train
train_fraud_n <- min(train_fraud_n, length(fraud_idx) - 1)
train_nonfraud_n <- min(train_nonfraud_n, length(nonfraud_idx) - 1)

train_fraud <- sample(fraud_idx, size = train_fraud_n)
train_nonfraud <- sample(nonfraud_idx, size = train_nonfraud_n)

train_claim_idx <- sort(c(train_fraud, train_nonfraud))
test_claim_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df_gnn)), train_claim_idx)

# Final verification
cat("Train class distribution:\n")
print(table(df_gnn$FraudFound[train_claim_idx]))

cat("Test class distribution:\n")
print(table(df_gnn$FraudFound[test_claim_idx]))

if (length(unique(df_gnn$FraudFound[test_claim_idx])) < 2) {
  stop("Step 9 error: test set still has only one class.")
}

train_claims <- df_gnn$ClaimID[train_claim_idx]
test_claims  <- df_gnn$ClaimID[test_claim_idx]

train_mask <- nodes$node_id %in% train_claims
test_mask  <- nodes$node_id %in% test_claims
claim_mask <- nodes$node_type == "claim"

saveRDS(train_claim_idx, file.path(pred_dir, "gnn_train_claim_idx.rds"))
saveRDS(test_claim_idx, file.path(pred_dir, "gnn_test_claim_idx.rds"))

cat("✓ Saved train/test claim indices\n")
```

Step 12: Python GCN model
```{r}
py_run_string("
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

# -----------------------------
# Load data from R
# -----------------------------
X_np = np.array(X_all, dtype=np.float32)
y_np = np.array(y_all, dtype=np.int64)

train_mask_np = np.array(train_mask, dtype=bool)
test_mask_np = np.array(test_mask, dtype=bool)
claim_mask_np = np.array(claim_mask, dtype=bool)

edge_index_np = np.array(edge_index, dtype=np.int64)

# Defensive checks
X_np = np.nan_to_num(X_np, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

X = torch.tensor(X_np, dtype=torch.float32)
y = torch.tensor(y_np, dtype=torch.long)

train_mask = torch.tensor(train_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)
test_mask = torch.tensor(test_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)
claim_mask = torch.tensor(claim_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)

num_nodes = X.shape[0]

# -----------------------------
# Build sparse adjacency
# -----------------------------
row = edge_index_np[:, 0]
col = edge_index_np[:, 1]

# Add self-loops
self_loops = np.arange(num_nodes)
row = np.concatenate([row, self_loops])
col = np.concatenate([col, self_loops])

indices = torch.tensor(np.vstack([row, col]), dtype=torch.long)
values = torch.ones(indices.shape[1], dtype=torch.float32)

A = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(indices, values, (num_nodes, num_nodes)).coalesce()

# -----------------------------
# Sparse normalization
# -----------------------------
deg = torch.zeros(num_nodes, dtype=torch.float32)
deg.index_add_(0, A.indices()[0], A.values())

deg = torch.clamp(deg, min=1.0)
deg_inv_sqrt = torch.pow(deg, -0.5)

r = A.indices()[0]
c = A.indices()[1]
norm_values = deg_inv_sqrt[r] * A.values() * deg_inv_sqrt[c]

# Remove any bad values
norm_values = torch.nan_to_num(norm_values, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

A_hat = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(A.indices(), norm_values, (num_nodes, num_nodes)).coalesce()

# -----------------------------
# Sparse GCN
# -----------------------------
class GCNLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_features, out_features)

    def forward(self, X, A_hat):
        X = self.linear(X)
        return torch.sparse.mm(A_hat, X)

class GCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_dim, out_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.gcn1 = GCNLayer(in_features, hidden_dim)
        self.gcn2 = GCNLayer(hidden_dim, out_features)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)

    def forward(self, X, A_hat):
        x = self.gcn1(X, A_hat)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.gcn2(x, A_hat)
        return x

model = GCN(in_features=X.shape[1], hidden_dim=16, out_features=2)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.005, weight_decay=1e-4)

num_pos = (y[train_mask] == 1).sum().item()
num_neg = (y[train_mask] == 0).sum().item()
class_weights = torch.tensor([1.0, num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)], dtype=torch.float32)

# -----------------------------
# Train
# -----------------------------
for epoch in range(1, 101):
    model.train()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    out = model(X, A_hat)

    # Defensive cleanup
    out = torch.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    loss = F.cross_entropy(out[train_mask], y[train_mask], weight=class_weights)
    loss.backward()

    # Gradient clipping
    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)

    optimizer.step()

# -----------------------------
# Final outputs
# -----------------------------
model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    logits = model(X, A_hat)
    logits = torch.nan_to_num(logits, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)[:, 1].cpu().numpy()
    preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1).cpu().numpy()

# Final defensive cleanup
probs = np.nan_to_num(probs, nan=0.5, posinf=0.5, neginf=0.5)

claim_probs = probs[claim_mask_np]
claim_preds = preds[claim_mask_np]
claim_labels = y_np[claim_mask_np]
")
```

Step 14: Evaluate GNN properly
```{r}
test_probs_eval <- as.numeric(claim_probs[test_claim_idx])
test_labels_eval <- as.integer(df_gnn$FraudFound[test_claim_idx])
test_preds_eval <- ifelse(test_probs_eval >= 0.5, 1, 0)

cat("Test label distribution:\n")
print(table(test_labels_eval))

cat("Finite probs in test set:\n")
print(table(is.finite(test_probs_eval), useNA = "ifany"))

conf_mat <- caret::confusionMatrix(
  factor(test_preds_eval, levels = c(0, 1)),
  factor(test_labels_eval, levels = c(0, 1)),
  positive = "1"
)

print(conf_mat)

precision <- conf_mat$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
recall <- conf_mat$byClass["Sensitivity"]
f1_score <- ifelse((precision + recall) == 0, 0, 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))

cat("Precision:", round(precision, 4), "\n")
cat("Recall:", round(recall, 4), "\n")
cat("F1 Score:", round(f1_score, 4), "\n")

if (all(c(0, 1) %in% unique(test_labels_eval))) {
  roc_obj <- pROC::roc(test_labels_eval, test_probs_eval, quiet = TRUE)
  roc_auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj))

  pr_obj <- PRROC::pr.curve(
    scores.class0 = test_probs_eval[test_labels_eval == 1],
    scores.class1 = test_probs_eval[test_labels_eval == 0],
    curve = TRUE
  )

  cat("ROC-AUC:", round(roc_auc, 4), "\n")
  cat("PR-AUC:", round(pr_obj$auc.integral, 4), "\n")
}
```

Step 16: Generate OOF predictions for stacking
```{r}
generate_gnn_oof <- function(df_input, n_folds = 5) {
  
  library(reticulate)
  
  # Ensure Python is initialized
  use_python(Sys.which("python"), required = FALSE)
  py_config()
  
  if (!py_available(initialize = TRUE)) {
    stop("Python is not available for Step 16.")
  }
  
  # Use Python main namespace
  main <- import_main(convert = FALSE)
  
  folds <- createFolds(df_input$FraudFound, k = n_folds, list = TRUE)
  oof_pred <- numeric(nrow(df_input))
  
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    cat("Fold:", i, "\n")
    
    val_idx <- folds[[i]]
    tr_idx <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(df_input)), val_idx)
    
    train_claims_fold <- df_input$ClaimID[tr_idx]
    val_claims_fold <- df_input$ClaimID[val_idx]
    
    train_mask_fold <- nodes$node_id %in% train_claims_fold
    val_mask_fold <- nodes$node_id %in% val_claims_fold
    
    # Send data to Python safely
    main$X_all <- r_to_py(as.matrix(X_all))
    main$y_all <- r_to_py(as.integer(y_all))
    main$train_mask <- r_to_py(as.integer(train_mask_fold))
    main$test_mask <- r_to_py(as.integer(val_mask_fold))
    main$claim_mask <- r_to_py(as.integer(claim_mask))
    main$edge_index <- r_to_py(as.matrix(edge_index_df))
    
    py_run_string("
import numpy as np
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

# -----------------------------
# Load fold data
# -----------------------------
X_np = np.array(X_all, dtype=np.float32)
y_np = np.array(y_all, dtype=np.int64)

train_mask_np = np.array(train_mask, dtype=bool)
test_mask_np = np.array(test_mask, dtype=bool)
claim_mask_np = np.array(claim_mask, dtype=bool)

edge_index_np = np.array(edge_index, dtype=np.int64)

X_np = np.nan_to_num(X_np, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

X = torch.tensor(X_np, dtype=torch.float32)
y = torch.tensor(y_np, dtype=torch.long)

train_mask = torch.tensor(train_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)
test_mask = torch.tensor(test_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)
claim_mask = torch.tensor(claim_mask_np, dtype=torch.bool)

num_nodes = X.shape[0]

# -----------------------------
# Sparse adjacency
# -----------------------------
row = edge_index_np[:, 0]
col = edge_index_np[:, 1]

self_loops = np.arange(num_nodes)
row = np.concatenate([row, self_loops])
col = np.concatenate([col, self_loops])

indices = torch.tensor(np.vstack([row, col]), dtype=torch.long)
values = torch.ones(indices.shape[1], dtype=torch.float32)

A = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(indices, values, (num_nodes, num_nodes)).coalesce()

deg = torch.zeros(num_nodes, dtype=torch.float32)
deg.index_add_(0, A.indices()[0], A.values())

deg = torch.clamp(deg, min=1.0)
deg_inv_sqrt = torch.pow(deg, -0.5)

r = A.indices()[0]
c = A.indices()[1]
norm_values = deg_inv_sqrt[r] * A.values() * deg_inv_sqrt[c]
norm_values = torch.nan_to_num(norm_values, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

A_hat = torch.sparse_coo_tensor(A.indices(), norm_values, (num_nodes, num_nodes)).coalesce()

# -----------------------------
# GCN
# -----------------------------
class GCNLayer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, out_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.linear = nn.Linear(in_features, out_features)

    def forward(self, X, A_hat):
        X = self.linear(X)
        return torch.sparse.mm(A_hat, X)

class GCN(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features, hidden_dim, out_features):
        super().__init__()
        self.gcn1 = GCNLayer(in_features, hidden_dim)
        self.gcn2 = GCNLayer(hidden_dim, out_features)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(0.2)

    def forward(self, X, A_hat):
        x = self.gcn1(X, A_hat)
        x = F.relu(x)
        x = self.dropout(x)
        x = self.gcn2(x, A_hat)
        return x

model = GCN(in_features=X.shape[1], hidden_dim=16, out_features=2)
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.005, weight_decay=1e-4)

num_pos = (y[train_mask] == 1).sum().item()
num_neg = (y[train_mask] == 0).sum().item()
class_weights = torch.tensor([1.0, num_neg / max(num_pos, 1)], dtype=torch.float32)

for epoch in range(1, 81):
    model.train()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    out = model(X, A_hat)
    out = torch.nan_to_num(out, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)

    loss = F.cross_entropy(out[train_mask], y[train_mask], weight=class_weights)
    loss.backward()
    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(model.parameters(), max_norm=1.0)
    optimizer.step()

model.eval()
with torch.no_grad():
    logits = model(X, A_hat)
    logits = torch.nan_to_num(logits, nan=0.0, posinf=0.0, neginf=0.0)
    probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=1)[:, 1].cpu().numpy()

probs = np.nan_to_num(probs, nan=0.5, posinf=0.5, neginf=0.5)

claim_probs_fold = probs[claim_mask_np]
")
    
    # Pull back fold claim probabilities
    main2 <- import_main(convert = TRUE)
    claim_probs_fold <- main2$claim_probs_fold
    
    # Store only validation predictions
    oof_pred[val_idx] <- as.numeric(claim_probs_fold[val_idx])
  }
  
  return(oof_pred)
}

gnn_oof_predictions <- generate_gnn_oof(df_gnn, n_folds = 5)

summary(gnn_oof_predictions)
sum(is.na(gnn_oof_predictions))

saveRDS(gnn_oof_predictions, file.path(pred_dir, "gnn_oof_predictions.rds"))
```
